premise: Rabbit's big ears hear his friends whispering about a birthday surprise for him, so he pretends he heard nothing all day — and gives them the most surprised face in the forest.
inspiration: The Emperor's New Clothes (Andersen), turned: here pretending not to know is the kind thing, and the secret stays safe with a friend.
lesson: Sometimes the kind thing is to let friends surprise you.

en-US.title: Rabbit Hears a Surprise
en-US.text: {rabbit:enter} Rabbit had the biggest ears in the meadow. One morning, {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:live listen hold} they shot straight up. Far across the grass, someone was whispering. [whispers] "Shh! A birthday surprise for Rabbit, this afternoon. Don't tell!" A surprise? For HIM? Rabbit could have shouted, "I heard you!" But he didn't. {rabbit:live listen resume} He just nibbled his clover. All day, his friends acted very funny. {squirrel:enter} {squirrel:go to rabbit} Squirrel bounded by and {squirrel:live hide-nut hold} hid something behind her back, looking ever so innocent. {bee:enter} {bee:go to rabbit} {sfx:buzz} Bee buzzed past, {bee:face surprised} {bee:shake} saw Rabbit… and {bee:go away} zoomed off, giggling. [giggles] {rabbit:face happy} Rabbit didn't say a word. That afternoon, {raccoon:enter} {raccoon:go to rabbit} Raccoon came creeping up. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:live peekaboo} He hid his eyes… peeked… {canvas:confetti} {sfx:popper} [excited] "SURPRISE!" {bee:go back} {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:hop x3} [gasps] "For ME?" cried Rabbit, with the most surprised face in the forest. {all:face happy} {bee:go to rabbit} {squirrel:live hide-nut resume} Out came Squirrel's present: her very best hazelnut. {bee:live hum} And Bee hummed a birthday tune. {rabbit:tint #FFC0D0} [playfully] Rabbit's big ears turned pink. Those ears had heard everything. But they never told.

es-ES.title: Las orejas de Conejo
es-ES.text: {rabbit:enter} Conejo tenía las orejas más grandes del prado. Una mañana, {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:live listen hold} se le pusieron de punta. A lo lejos, alguien cuchicheaba. [whispers] —¡Chsss! Esta tarde, sorpresa de cumpleaños para Conejo. ¡No se lo digáis! ¿Una sorpresa? ¿Para ÉL? Podría haber gritado «¡Os he oído!». Pero no lo hizo. {rabbit:live listen resume} Siguió mordisqueando su trébol. Todo el día, sus amigos estuvieron rarísimos. {squirrel:enter} {squirrel:go to rabbit} Ardilla pasó dando brincos y {squirrel:live hide-nut hold} escondió algo detrás de la espalda, con cara de no haber roto un plato. {bee:enter} {bee:go to rabbit} {sfx:buzz} Abeja pasó zumbando, {bee:face surprised} {bee:shake} vio a Conejo… y {bee:go away} salió disparada entre risitas. [giggles] {rabbit:face happy} Conejo no dijo ni pío. Por la tarde, {raccoon:enter} {raccoon:go to rabbit} Mapache se acercó de puntillas. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:live peekaboo} Se tapó los ojos… espió… {canvas:confetti} {sfx:popper} [excited] —¡SORPRESA! {bee:go back} {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:hop x3} [gasps] —¿Para MÍ? —exclamó Conejo, con la cara más sorprendida del bosque. {all:face happy} {bee:go to rabbit} {squirrel:live hide-nut resume} Ardilla sacó su regalo: su mejor avellana. {bee:live hum} Y Abeja le tarareó una canción de cumpleaños. {rabbit:tint #FFC0D0} [playfully] A Conejo se le pusieron las orejas coloradas. Esas orejas lo habían oído todo. Pero nunca dijeron nada.
